updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to join and create Microsoft Teams meetings

User impact: Users may be unable to join and create Microsoft Teams meetings.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to join and create Microsoft Teams meetings

User impact: Users may be unable to join and create Microsoft Teams meetings.

More info: Based on our telemetry, multiple Microsoft Teams features are affected:
- Live Events
- 1:1 Calling
- PSTN Calling
- Joining Meetings
- Creating Meetings
- Meeting General Functionality


Current status: We have determined that maintenance related work was being conducted on the infrastructure based in Asia-Pacific. As an unintended result of this maintenance work, service health was impacted. We have paused our maintenance work and our telemetry indicates that the issue is no longer occurring. We're continuing to monitor service health and work with reporting users that the issue is no longer occurring. 


Scope of impact: This issue could affect any user located in Asia-Pacific. This section is subject to change as our investigation continues. 

Start time: Wednesday, August 26, 2026, at 1:00 AM UTC

Root cause: Maintenance related work in the region is inadvertently causing impact to service health. We will provide more information regarding the root cause as soon as possible. 

Next update by: Wednesday, August 26, 2026, at 3:00 AM UTC
